what: The parser found a character it cannot read as JavaScript. An unclosed quote or a character pasted from another program is a common cause.

street.headline: JavaScript no fit read one character
street.happen: JavaScript see one character wey e no understand. Most times, na quote wey no close, or strange symbol wey you paste.
street.todo: Check your quotes. Every opening quote must get a closing one. Remove strange characters wey you copy from outside.
street.learn: "invalid" mean say JavaScript no fit read am as code.
